Tree It v1.37

In this update I have added a Leaf cutout tool, this allows you to plot vertices down and create faces for creating custom leaf mesh shapes. If you wish to use the previous version you can select "sep-14" from the beta branch.

• Leaf cutout tool added - used for creating a custom leaf mesh.
• Leaf attachment reworked - offset/pivot along the Y axis now follows the bend of leaf geometry (fixes floating leaves).
• Made some improvements the texture atlas tool.
• End segment options for trunk/branches (tapered/caped/open).
• Added +/- button for better access to customise quantity's.
• The last 6 saved projects will be displayed in the file menu.

Tree It v1.36

This update adds the use of a curvature graph system to which this fundamentally changes the way tree it's curvature system works. If you wish to use the previous version you can select "apr-24" from the beta branch.

• Curvature Graphs, this gives you more control over a parameters behaviour.
• Additional random +/- values to parameters.
• All leaf "stem" parameter controls have moved into the same group.
• High-res shadows has been added to the options window.
• Set seek direction added to tools menu, this sets the seek sun orientation to that of the camera useful for creating wind swept trees.
• Added checkbox for enabling/disabling branch flare welding (under the flare group).
• Added checkbox for enabling/disabling inheritance of length/radius under shape for branches/leaves/
meshes.
• Added checkbox for enabling/disabling vertex indexing added to trunk/branches, used for flat shading.
• Fixed leaf smoothing orientation for normal's, was not smoothing from the correct position after the first leaf was generated.
• Some improvements made to meshes.
 - You can now add up to 2000 mesh objects per-node to your tree.
 - High poly models imports are now partitioned to fit the limited vertex buffer size making them loadable.
 - Texture slots are now shared, so partitioned models are treated as a single model.
 - Vertex index buffer size ignored on .fbx and .obj exports making hi poly exports consist of fewer meshes.

Tree It 1.35 

- Side/segment extrusion added.
- Rework of normal/tangents calculations.
- Position/rotate/scale transform widget now use floating point precision.
- Started to rework some of the mesh system, compiling shaders for meshes are no longer required (faster loading).
- Cacti Pack, joshua tree pack and desert shrubs pack added
- Alpha Mask value added to options window.
- Reset/restore settings added to options window.
- Changed Twist trunk/branches, now works as an in-line twist.

Tree it 1.3

Sorry for the delay and there are quite few changes here, if you don't like them you can roll back to aug 22 via the beta branch.

- Node tree added should make creating trees a bit easier, you can disable this by going options>interface to revert back to the existing method of tabs/layers.
- Creation toolbar added on the left side this is where you now add new trunk/branch/leaf/mesh components (previously layers) as well as delete/duplicate/rename/show selected.
- Additional trunk components can now be created.
- Displacements now moved to the side panel under the texture group.
- Leaf joints now shared with tree joints (trunk/branches).
- Transform widget (position/scale/rotate) is now used when selecting a trunk component.
- Dynamic sky with clouds.
- Universal texture set window with support for additional textures such as metalness and AO texture maps added.
- Texture browsers added makes it much faster to browse textures added to the textures folder.
- knowed texture types will fill the texture set when base texture applied**
- Branches can now have a separate texture assigned to them.
- Space key + mouse click will insert a mesh at the cursors location.

** List of knowed texture extension for auto filling the texure set.

alpha.xxx
opacity.xxx

_n.xxx
nrm.xxx
normal.xxx
normaldx.xxx
normal-dx.xxx
normal4-ue.xxx
normalmap.xxx

_h.xxx
height.xxx
heightmap.xxx
displacement.xxx

metallic.xxx
metal.xxx
metalness.xxx
 
_s.xxx
roughness.xxx
rough.xxx

ao.xxx
ambientocclusion.xxx
ambient occlusion.xxx

_t.xxx
translucency.xxx
transmission.xxx

emission.xxx
emissive.xxx

* Quantity for branches/leaves allows for the creation of more individual branches and leaf geometry.
* Save/Load has been completely restructured with the added support for loading previous version .tre files.
* Level of detail added allows to create up to 5 different LOD levels, these are generated and saved upon export.
* Ambient occlusion reworked to calculate faster.
* Branch layers can now be attached to other branch layers with a twig preset option when creating a new branch layer.
* Ui elements are generated only when necessary instead of generating everything right on startup, the side panel can now also be resized.

* Joint selection influence added, when editing a joint the corresponding joints will also be altered allowing to create custom bends in your trunk/branches.
* Texture previews are now downsized via the gpu instead of cpu, should make selecting/loading textures faster.
* Trunk blend texture drop down combo boxes now show the correct texture type for roughness and normal maps.
* Some changes were made to the way gravity and curvature values work, this might make you tree look slightly diffrent and may require re-tweaking some values.
* Steam overlay was enabled, you can take screenshots in fullscreen by disabling the sidepanel and toolbar in view>window menu.
* Deleting meshes should no longer cause a crash.
